# VS Code C/C++ grammar notice

The files under `syntaxes/` were copied from the built-in `cpp` extension in
Microsoft Visual Studio Code 1.135.0. That extension declares the MIT license
and records that its generated C/C++ grammars originate from Jeff Hykin's
Better C Syntax and Better C++ Syntax projects.

Upstream package metadata:

- repository: `https://github.com/microsoft/vscode.git`
- extension: `extensions/cpp`
- package version: `10.0.0`
- license: MIT
